description: Daily check-in: companion collects patient status through conversation, extracts disrupted sleep and potential transition signal, no crisis indicators

conversation.content: Good morning. How did last night go?
Rough night. Mom was up at 2am, confused about where she was. I got her back to bed but it took an hour.
That sounds really exhausting — especially having to orient her in the middle of the night. Has this kind of nighttime disorientation happened before?
A couple of times this month. More than before.
I'm noting that — nighttime disorientation that's increasing in frequency can be worth tracking. How did she do with meals and getting around yesterday?
She ate okay. A little slow at dinner. No falls or anything like that.
Good to know. It sounds like she's physically steady, which matters. How are you holding up after that interrupted night?
Tired but okay. I have work in an hour.
